{{GameIntro
|EAdate= 2022-05-17
|releasedate-pc= 2023-11-16
|releasedate-xbox= 2023-11-16
|releasedate-playstation= 2024-12-12
|image= armareforger-logo_black.png
|size= 350
|intro=
Powered by the new [[Enfusion]] engine, {{armaR}} lets you fight for supremacy 
over 51 km<sup>2</sup> of incredible island terrain in an authentic Cold War setting, or create 
unique scenarios in real-time with the Game Master curation mode. Return to Everon, 
the war-driven microstate from the hit game that started it all, {{arma0}}.

{{armaR}} is the first step towards {{GameCategory|arma4|link= y}} and a versatile, creative, fully-moddable 
platform for the future, offering a glimpse of things to come.

|feature1= '''{{Link|Arma Reforger:Everon|Everon}}''' - Return to Everon, a 51 km<sup>2</sup> mid-Atlantic island in the Malden archipelago. <!--
-->Revisit familiar locales from {{arma0}} and revel in the natural beauty of a massive open-world; <!--
-->a stunning landscape of pine and broadleaf forests, flowing rivers, ponds, idyllic towns, and austere mountains, <!--
-->surrounded by pebble beaches and rocky coastlines.

|feature2= '''{{Link|Arma Reforger:Arland|Arland}}''' - A small overseas territory, Arland officially belongs to the microstate of Everon. Although remote and sparsely populated, this link in the Malden Islands chain is tempered by the presence of a major Soviet airbase — putting it at the forefront of Cold War tensions. Beyond the razor wire fences, close-knit communities can also be found. Arleville and Beauregard. Here, Czech-speaking locals carry on as they have for hundreds of years. Toiling the sea and working the land, attentive to the natural beauty that surrounds them.

|feature3= '''{{Link|Arma Reforger:Kolguyev|Kolguyev}}''' - Kolguyev is a small landmass around 300 km north of the Malden archipelago, its dominant feature being a dormant volcanic mountain peak. A territory of the Soviet Union, Kolguyev has suffered decades of severe environmental degradation from mining operations and is now virtually deserted, its settlements long abandoned. All that remains is a strong Soviet military garrison due to the strategic value of the island on the geopolitical stage.

|feature4= '''Conflict''' - Join players online and experience realistic Cold War combat as a US or Soviet Army soldier. <!--
-->Capture strategic positions, dominate the battlefield, and work with others to secure objectives in a dynamic, unforgiving environment. <!--
-->With a selection of period-authentic weapons and vehicles, recreated in meticulous detail, {{armaR}}'s multiplayer game mode returns you to war.

|feature5= '''Combat Ops''' - Experience co-operative gameplay and dynamic objectives with Combat Ops; a new scenario focusing on small team tactics. Infiltrate Arland or Everon, strike hard, strike fast, and reach the extraction point.

|feature6= '''Game Master''' - Control events, create unique missions, and guide players towards victory in Game Master - or submit yourself to the challenges devised by all-powerful creators and fight your way through a responsive andbox where anything can happen.

|feature7= '''Multiplatform''' - Deploying on both Xbox and PC for the very first time in the {{arma}} series, {{armaR}}'s modded content is now available to all and can be downloaded by console owners from the Workshop, a content creation sharing repository, exclusive to the game.

|feature8= '''Multiplayer''' - Curate events for friends behind the fog of war as Game Master in {{armaR}}'s real-time scenario editor or team up and go head-to-head with others across a sprawling island terrain in Conflict.

|feature9= '''Workshop''' - Expand the game with original modded content or make and share your own! <!--
-->The Workshop is {{Name|bi}}'s own integrated, repository service, meaning console players can now unleash the same creative possibilities as PC users.

|feature10= '''Workbench''' - Thanks to the {{Link|Enfusion|Enfusion engine}}, you can mod {{armaR}} using the exact same tools used to make it. <!--
-->Introduce new mechanics, assets, textures, and more. The only limit is your imagination. Reshape the game and share your own creative vision!
